texts.orig: The rest of this paper is organized as follows. In section 2, we describe the spectral Legendre-Fourier scheme we used to discretize equation (1.1) defined in an elliptic geometry. The IAOBDM is designed and presented in section 3. In section 4, ample numerical experiments are carried out to demonstrate the efficiency of this method, and to show the effect of varying geometry Ω on multiple solutions of (1.1). Finally, we end the paper with some remarks in section 5.
